data.desc: ACCO Brands is a global leader in branded technology peripherals, workspace solutions, education and creative products that enable people to work with more productivity, learn with more confidence and play with more enjoyment. We develop, nurture and acquire a portfolio of distinct, innovative and widely recognized brands, including EPOS, Five Star, Kensington, Leitz, Mead, PowerA, Tilibra, Trust and many others.
